title: Sumatra : Res. Sumatra's Westkust – blad 85

series.title: Sumatra : Res. Sumatra's Westkust
series.notes: Topographic map series of west Sumatra, Indonesia showing roads, railroads and populated places; some sheets also show vegetation, cultivated areas and water features. Relief shown by contours, shading and spot heights. | Catalogued from Blad 2."Herzien door den Topopgrafischen dienst in 1930" | Prime meridian: Padang. Coordinates converted to Greenwich. | Includes bladindeeling and administrative indeeling.

creator: Netherlands. Topografische Dienst, cartographer. issuing body.
